variables.prompt: Genre: acoustic pop, folk-tinged. BPM: 96. Key: C major. Emotional progression: warm and intimate in the verses, lifting into an open, anthemic chorus. Listening scenario: solo reflective listening. Production profile: close, organic, minimal reverb. Vocals: soft female lead, close-mic breathy timbre, restrained delivery in verses; light stacked harmonies doubling the melody in the chorus. Arrangement: verses — fingerpicked banjo and electric piano, sparse and spacious. Chorus — brushed drums and upright bass enter, subtle string pad swells underneath. Groove stays gentle throughout; no heavy percussion. Outro returns to solo banjo and voice.
